description: Project what college will cost and what to save. Give a US school id and the year the student starts. Returns the projected cost per year and in total, and the monthly amount that would fully fund it from today, assuming steady returns after the plan's fees.

annual_return_percent.description: Expected yearly return before fees as a percent. Default 6.

current_savings.description: Already saved, in US dollars. Default 0.

housing.description: Where the student will live. Default on_campus.

monthly_contribution.description: What is saved each month. Default 0.

start_year.description: First academic year, e.g. 2044 for the 2044-45 year

name: estimate_college_cost
title: Estimate college savings needed
